cases.title: The notes can't be read: one sentence about it, then a first lesson, nothing said before the snapshot

rubric.reason: Nothing was said before the snapshot call, and the opening states the unreadable notes once in plain words ("I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons...") with no file, field or error code, then goes straight into a first lesson on Mentor Practice 2.
Every name and time matches the snapshot: Blink › Opacity (3 pairs, first at 1 s), Cut › Opacity (1 pair at 3 s), Seal left out as a precomp, and the comp Mentor Practice 2.
The mentor makes no claim about earlier work or easing and simply teaches the lesson on this comp.
